items.question: Who is Venkat Rangapuram?
items.answer: Venkat Rangapuram is the Chief Executive Officer at Centific, a Seattle-based tech company focused on pioneering AI solutions. They bring expertise in transforming complex business and technology challenges into strategic solutions. Prior to Centific, Venkat served as Chief Executive Officer at Pactera EDGE, a global digital and technology servic... es company. Their career reflects a strong focus on global technology services leadership, having also held the position of Senior Vice President, GM- North America and Europe Markets at Pactera, with P&L responsibility. At Pactera, they also served as Senior Vice President, managing global client partnerships and strategic alliances. Building on this experience, Venkat was a Senior Director at HCL Technologies, a global IT services company. Earlier in their career, they held multiple roles at Infosys, including Senior Manager, Engagement, and Program Manager, where they managed large enterprise accounts, focusing on revenue growth, profitability, client relationships, and employee satisfaction. Their work history includes program management of large programs for Hi-Tech, Banking, and Insurance clients, as well as business development. They also served as a Systems Analyst at Infosys.
